result.summary: 这篇论文提出“柏拉图表示假说”，认为不同 AI 模型（尤其是深度网络）对数据的表示正在趋同，并可能收敛到一种共享的、关于现实统计结构的表示 [abstract][S1.p4]。作者综述了文献中跨模型、跨模态的趋同证据，并用视觉与语言模型的相互最近邻对齐度进行测量，发现模型越大、能力越强，表示越相似 [abstract][S2.F3]。论文还讨论了推动这种趋同的可能选择压力、其含义、局限与反例 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要回答的核心问题是：不同 AI 模型的表示是否正在趋同，以及这种趋同是否指向一个共享的、关于现实联合分布的表示 [S1.p4]。作者指出，AI 系统在架构和能力上正变得越来越同质化，因此需要理解这种趋同是否有终点和驱动原则 [S1.p1][S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: AI systems are becoming increasingly homogeneous in both their architectures and their capabilities.

Our central hypothesis, stated above in Figure 1, is that there is indeed an endpoint to this convergence and a principle that drives it: different models are all trying to arrive at a representation of reality, meaning a representation of the joint distribution over events in the world that generate the data we observe.

method.text: 论文提出“柏拉图表示假说”，即存在一个真实世界 Z，各种传感器测量和文本描述都是它的投影，表示学习算法找到的向量嵌入都源自 Z，因而会趋于对齐 [S1.p4]。作者用相互最近邻对齐度来测量模型表示之间的相似性，并考察对齐度随模型规模、能力和跨模态的变化 [S2.F3][S2.SS2.p1]。此外，作者还构建了一个理想化世界模型，将世界视为离散事件序列，观测是双射确定性函数 [S4.SS1.p1]。

evidence.quote: Representation learning algorithms find vector embeddings that statistically model the various measurements and projections.
The resulting vector embeddings are all derived from the underlying reality in $Z$ and thereby become aligned.
We measure alignment using mutual nearest-neighbor on the Wikipedia caption dataset (WIT).
observed model alignment not only exists but also increases with model scale and dataset size.
The world consists of a sequence of $T$ discrete events, denoted as $\mathbf{Z}\triangleq[z_{1},\ldots,z_{T}]$, sampled from some unknown distribution $\mathbb{P}(\mathbf{Z})$.
An observation is a bijective, deterministic function $\texttt{obs}:\mathcal{Z}\rightarrow\cdot{}$ that maps events to an arbitrary measurement space

experiments.text: 在视觉-视觉对齐方面，作者使用 78 个视觉模型（包括 17 个 ViT、1 个随机初始化 ResNet-50、11 个 ResNet-50 和 49 个 ResNet-18），在 Places-365 上用相互最近邻测量对齐度，并在 VTAB 的 19 个分类任务上评估线性探测性能 [A3.SS1.p1][A3.SS1.p2][S2.F2.fig1]。在语言-视觉对齐方面，作者在 Wikipedia 标题数据集（WIT）上测量对齐度，语言模型性能用 OpenWebText 的 4M tokens 上的 1-bits-per-byte 衡量 [S2.F3]。此外，作者还进行了颜色案例研究，用图像共现的 K_PMI 学习颜色表示，并在 Densely Captioned Images 数据集上用 LLaMA3-8B-Instruct 生成不同密度的标题来测试对齐度 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1][A5.p1][A5.p4]。

evidence.quote: We consider 78 vision models in total:
17 ViT models ranging from ViT-tiny to ViT-giant
1 randomly initialized ResNet-50.
11 ResNet-50 models trained with contrastive learning on ImageNet-1k, Places-365, and 9 synthetic image datasets
49 ResNet-18 models trained with Alignment and Uniformity contrastive loss on ImageNet-100, Places-365, and 47 realistic and synthetic image datasets
we evaluate linear probing performance on all 19 VTAB classification tasks
We measure alignment among 78 models using mutual nearest-neighbors on Places-365
We measure alignment using mutual nearest-neighbor on the Wikipedia caption dataset (WIT).
The x-axis is the language model performance measured over 4M tokens from the OpenWebText dataset
We measure performance using $1-\texttt{bits-per-byte}$
we also learn representations of color based on $K_{\mathsf{PMI}}$ from cooccurrences in images.
We use LLaMA3-8B-Instruct to generate summary captions at various densities for images in the Densely Captioned Images dataset
we find that the alignment score also improves as caption length increases.

findings.text: 论文发现，能力更强的视觉模型彼此之间更对齐，且更通用 [S2.F2.fig1]；语言模型能力越强，与视觉模型的对齐也越好，其中 CLIP 模型因显式语言监督而对齐更高，但在 ImageNet 分类微调后对齐下降 [S2.F3]。对齐度随模型规模和数据集增大而增加 [S2.SS2.p1]。跨模态方面，单一线性投影即可将视觉模型与 LLM 拼接并取得良好性能 [S2.SS3.p2]。对齐度提高与常识推理（Hellaswag）和数学问题求解（GSM8K）性能提升相关 [S2.SS5.p1]。颜色案例研究表明，从文本或图像共现中学习都能恢复大致相同的感知表示 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: Models that solve more VTAB tasks tend to be more aligned with each other.
More competent and general models (blue) have more similar representations.

The results show a linear relationship between language-vision alignment and language modeling score, where a general trend is that more capable language models align better with more capable vision models.
We find that CLIP models, which are trained with explicit language supervision, exhibit a higher level of alignment.
However, this alignment decreases after being fine-tuned on ImageNet classification (labeled CLIP (I12K ft)).
observed model alignment not only exists but also increases with model scale and dataset size.
finding that a single linear projection is sufficient to stitch a vision model to an LLM and achieve good performance on visual question answering and image captioning.
Figure 4 supports this hypothesis by demonstrating improved performance on commonsense reasoning (Hellaswag;) and mathematical problem solving (GSM8K;) as alignment improves.
learning cooccurrence statistics in either domain recovers roughly the same perceptual representation.

limitations.text: 作者承认，不同传感器和视角可能捕获不同信息，这可能限制它们收敛到完全相同的表示 [S1.p4]。不同模态可能包含独有信息，若输入信号信息不同，两个模型无法收敛到同一表示；更精细的假说需要处理非双射观测和抽象概念 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p3]。作者还指出，当前对齐分数仅达到 0.16（理论最大值为 1），这究竟意味着强对齐还是存在重大差异，仍是未决问题 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px6.p1]。此外，AI 社区的研究者偏见和“硬件彩票”也可能影响趋同趋势 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

evidence.quote: different sensors and views might capture different information, which may limit their potential to converge to identical representations.
Two different models cannot converge to the same representation if they have access to fundamentally different information.
A more nuanced version of our hypothesis will need to be developed to handle the case of non-bijective observations and abstract concepts.
alignment clearly increases but only reaches a score of $0.16$, according to our mutual nearest-neighbor metric.
We leave this as an open question.
Researcher bias and collective preferences within the AI community have shaped the trajectory of model development.
the “hardware lottery” suggests that the success of AI models can also depend on the compatibility of their design with available computational architectures
